# Tayb Meals

> Tayb Meals is a monthly mess food and tiffin service in Dubai, UAE. It delivers halal, homestyle Kerala, Tamil Nadu / South Indian and North Indian meals to homes and offices all across Dubai, Monday to Saturday, with an optional Sunday add-on.

## Key facts
- Plans: AED 199/month (1 meal a day), AED 359/month (2 meals a day), AED 459/month (3 meals a day)
- Meals: breakfast, lunch and dinner; 250+ dishes; menu changes every week; custom or fixed menus; veg options
- Styles: Kerala, South Indian, North Indian (e.g. puttu, idiyappam, parotta, sambar, rasam, kuzhambu, biryani)
- Delivery: all across Dubai — 120+ areas incl. Dubai Marina, JLT, JBR, Palm Jumeirah, Business Bay, Downtown, Jebel Ali, Al Quoz, DIP, Dubai South, Discovery Gardens, Al Furjan, JVC, Dubai Production City, Karama, Bur Dubai, Deira, Al Nahda, Al Qusais, Mirdif, International City, Silicon Oasis, Warsan, Al Warqa, Al Jaddaf
- Sunday add-on: lunch only AED 30/month, lunch + dinner AED 50/month
- Starter Plan: payment is due on the 2nd day of delivery; if you stop, you pay only for the meals you received
- Payment: bank transfer, Aani, card payment link, Tabby, Tamara, CDM
- Hours: Mon–Sat 7:00 AM–9:00 PM, Sunday 11:00 AM–2:00 PM
- Order: register at https://taybmeals.paperform.co, then confirm on WhatsApp +971 50 948 7880
- Kitchen: Warsan 1st, France Cluster, Dubai
